description: FREE, no key needed. Analyze artwork for screen printing: how many spot-color screens it needs, the detected ink colors (with named ink matches), whether it's flat/vector or photographic, and whether screen printing or DTF is the better process. Use this first on any logo or design.

garment.description: Shirt the art prints on: "dark" (black, default), "light" (white), a color name (Navy, Royal, Red, Maroon, Forest, Gold, Heather Grey, Charcoal, ...) or a hex like "#1f2a44". The separation is solved against that exact shirt color.

image_b64.description: Base64 (or data URL) of the artwork — alternative to image_url

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the artwork (PNG/JPG, max 12 MB)

underbase.description: Print a white underbase (default: on for shirts darker than mid-grey)

name: estimate_screens
title: Estimate screens (free)
